answer: We define a cryptoeconomic mechanism where agents lock dynamic opportunity-cost bonds into a sovereign stake lagoon bound by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. At the zenith of adversarial identity multiplication, a subgame-perfect punishment matrix deploys an automated slashing plume that completely liquidates collateral assets across all Sybil nodes. Because the expected payoff of identity splitting strictly yields E[U_Sybil] < 0, honest validation converges as the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
